journey.name: DD-03 Cancelling the date picker leaves the date untouched
journey.description:
Covers FR-13's dismissal path. Cancel must not commit the highlighted date, and it must not clear an existing one either - a picker opened by "Change date" starts on the current value, so a careless dismiss handler would be easy to miss.
"Renew domain registration" already carries a date, which is what makes this the row to use.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that "Due in 3 days" is on screen
Verify that a date picker dialog is on screen
Select a different date in the picker and tap "Cancel"
Verify that the date picker dialog is no longer on screen
Verify that "Due in 3 days" is still on screen
Verify that "No due date" is not on screen
Tap the element with the content description "Back"
Verify that the "Renew domain registration" row still shows "Due in 3 days"
